title: Schlaefli orbit export
export_notes: DIMACS uses 1-based vertices. GAP/Sage support triples use the same 1-based vertices in GAP and 0-based vertices in Sage. BT1795 image uses 0-based support-line indices, matching prior BT1795-BT1803 data files.
conclusion: BT1806 exports the exact Schlaefli graph, 45 tritangent supports, and BT1795 image in portable formats for the W(E6) orbit computation.
